description: This script generates a flash image tag for firmware with metadata such as CRC32 checksum, version, chip ID, flash type, and flags. It reads input binary data, computes a CRC32, appends a structured tag, and writes the output.

methods.name: auto_int(x)
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, interpreting the base automatically.

methods.name: create_tag(args, in_bytes)
methods.description: Creates a metadata tag with CRC32 and other parameters by packing them into a binary structure.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads the input file, generates a tag, and writes the original data plus the tag to the output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, validates them, and invokes the output creation process.
